title: Gold Rewards Card: How to Contact Your Dedicated Concierge
summary: Explains how Gold Rewards Card customers contact their dedicated concierge: in-app chat (new Concierge thread from the card dashboard), email (include request details and deadlines; receive confirmation and a case reference), or phone (call concierge line for time-sensitive needs). Notes concierge is available 24/7 with initial acknowledgment within 2 hours and how to escalate/keep updates in the same thread.
faqs: How do I start an in-app Concierge request for my Gold Rewards Card?

If my request is time-sensitive, should I email or call the concierge line?
How quickly will the concierge acknowledge my request?
How do I send updates or urgency changes after I submit a request?
Will the concierge team accept around-the-clock requests, and what happens after acknowledgment?
